details.effect: On Evolve - Select an enemy follower on the field. Deal 1 damage to it and its leader.

issues: The On Evolve ability is missing target selection for the enemy follower. Encode it as damageFollowerAndLeader with the required selected enemy follower target, or use a sequence that first selects an enemy follower and then deals 1 damage to it and its leader.
